prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hand-drawn educational poster is pinned to a pale yellow wall, featuring a large iceberg partially submerged in water, rendered in simple pencil lines. The iceberg dominates the center of the page, with the waterline clearly marked, dividing the visible tip from the much larger submerged portion. At the top left of the iceberg, a small, cartoonish boat floats on the water, labeled with handwritten text. The iceberg itself is annotated with various handwritten notes, some above the waterline and many more densely clustered below, suggesting hidden depths and complexity. The name "Helen Barberi" is written in blue ink at the top right of the page. Two realistic, three-dimensional butterfly decorations—one blue and one orange—are affixed to the wall, partially overlapping the poster, adding a tactile, whimsical element. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. The composition is intimate and slightly off-center, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the poster and butterflies, while the background remains softly blurred. The overall style is documentary and candid, evoking a sense of personal creativity and educational exploration.
